Great powers win industrial revolutions. Britain won the first. America won the next two. Now China is determined to dominate the fourth.
 
In hindsight, it was a mistake for America to outsource so much of its industrial capacity over the last three decades. But decline isn’t inevitable. We still possess enormous advantages – from our innovation and capital markets to our alliances and natural resources – and China faces serious structural weaknesses of its own.
 
I break it all down with @Rush

The second homegrown terror plot disrupted this month. This one came dangerously close to being a 9/11 level catastrophe.
 
Federal authorities say five suspects are in custody so far for planning a coordinated attack on the UFC event involving explosive drones, a sniper team positioned along the evacuation route, and a follow-on assault on the White House. Investigators uncovered the plot just days before it was set to be carried out.
 
Outstanding work by the @FBI and @TheJusticeDept.

President Trump is right — the Senate Parliamentarian needs to go.
 
I said the same thing last year after she struck down my amendment ending taxpayer funding for sex reassignment procedures.
